newsitem.title: MEXICO: Cemex says it to receive $600 mln credit.
newsitem.headline: Cemex says it to receive $600 mln credit.

text.p: Mexican cement giant Cemex SA has negotiated a $600 million line of credit to cover its maturing short-term debts, the company said.

"The company recently received and accepted the commitment from a group of four banks that will act as co-leaders for a revolving, three-year syndicated loan worth $600 million," Cemex said in a breakdown of its 1996 results.
Cemex said it would use the loan to refinance maturing debt in the next 12 months and give the company more flexibility in issuing new paper.
Cemex said its debt at the end of 1996 was 37.579 billion pesos or about $4.769 billion. Of that total, $815 million is short-term debt and $3.954 billion is long-term debt.
